correctness.rationale: For all n>=5, no cycle wrap occurs in powers through degree four. Exact path enumeration gives five polynomial entry types. A negative discriminant proves two-jump positivity, the one-jump derivative has negative discriminant and negative leading coefficient, diagonal truncations are strictly positive, and distance-three signs are linear. The four-maximum-rate plateau and alpha bound are deduced algebraically from F(2/(a+b))=1/3 and row-stochastic diagonal control; one-defect phase and limiting alpha follow from a cubic identity and continuous root limits. Exact rational replay: 14,200 full matrix entries, 1,800 row sums, six phase identities; finite test limits separately stated.

value.rationale: A sharp O(n) local formula works for arbitrarily heterogeneous directed Markov cycles, replaces a global matrix positivity test and identifies when and by how much a conventional Euler positivity bound may be exceeded. The maximum-rate plateau iff criterion and exact defect-contrast failure-mode switch are structural, motivated timestep-design facts; neither is a mere isolated arithmetic example.
